title: Sour Lentil Stir-Fry
description: A hearty, tangy German-inspired lentil dish made with fresh vegetables and a hint of Italian spices. Perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: lentil
ingredients.notes: green or brown lentils work well

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and sauté until the vegetables are tender.
Add the lentils, Italian seasoning, crispy garlic, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the sour cream (if using).
Serve hot, garnished with additional Italian seasoning if desired.
Serve with a side of crusty bread or a green salad.
